name: Quick Stress Reset
description: A short session to de-stress in the middle of a hard day — no scheduling, no account, just a few minutes with a calming rhythm and atmosphere.

name: Better Sleep
description: An evening wind-down session designed to help you fall asleep faster, using the 4/7/8 rhythm with a dim, quiet background.

name: Morning Energy
description: A brief energizing session to start the day alert and focused, using the faster-paced Energy rhythm with a bright background.

name: Focus During Work
description: A short, distraction-free breathing break between meetings or tasks to reset concentration during the workday.

name: Evening Wind-Down
description: A calming end-of-day ritual that transitions from the day's stress into a relaxed state before settling in for the night.
